$Comment: Every dungeon milestone a player was in the room for: a ZigRunMilestone trigger volume counting once per run for each of its placements, with one line per milestone id beside the total (Room_Cleared, Puzzle_Solved, Secret_Found, or any id a pack names). Those three always file under that spelling, however a volume writes their case; any other id files as the volume writes it, so keep one spelling for it. It counts for every member standing in the run's area when the milestone fires. The library counts it itself off each milestone, so it lists no From; Breakdown names the line it files under, the milestone id (Target), and Qualifier or TargetAtQualifier add the dungeon id. An achievement reads it through ziggfreedcommon:counter, Param Dungeon_Milestones/Secret_Found.
